name: booth-desk
description: Offline manuscript proofing and ACX preparation for human audiobook recordings.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:core: esbuild src/core/acx/master.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/master.cjs && esbuild src/core/acx/export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/export.cjs && esbuild src/core/manuscript/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/manuscript.cjs && esbuild src/core/glossary/candidates.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/glossary.cjs && esbuild src/core/sharing/pack.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/sharing.cjs && esbuild src/core/markers/export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/markers.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/seats.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-seats.cjs && esbuild src/core/audio/wav.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/audio.cjs && esbuild src/core/audio/splice.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/splice.cjs && esbuild src/core/acx/room.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/room.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/mix.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-mix.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/timeline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-timeline.cjs && esbuild src/core/project/project.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/project.cjs
